title: Cosy table build 1: seated rivals and the new market board
problem: Build the approved mockup look (DEC-023, DEC-024, DEC-025; PLAN-008 versions 20 to 24) into the real game, starting with the table and the buying board. The game already has seats, a rival pop-up, a market and a demand/supply strip, so this restyles and rearranges them rather than rewriting them.
scope: Rivals sit in one slim row across the top of the table (works for 1 to 3 rivals, so 2 to 4 players); each seat shows portrait, name, cash and what they hold
Tap a rival's name: a drop-down shows their stock as freshness chips with nights left, the same as your stall (public information only)

Market board full width: one column per fruit, left to right; each column top-aligned from newest to not-so-fresh; every slot colour-coded by freshness (empty slots tinted), with a colour key; the side freshness bar is not used
The want / in-shops chips sit on top of each fruit column (same numbers as today's strip)
Your stall shows freshness chips with nights left
Colour-blind patterns on okay and not-so slots when the setting is on
Existing cards that sit on the board (morning, trait pick, showdown, summary) keep working; pricing and evening trays unchanged in this package
Update browser-test selectors and screenshots to the new layout
exclusions: Game rules, balance, saves, server, online protocol (no RULES_VERSION change)

acceptance.text: npm run verify:full passes (solo, performance budget, online with a leaver, quick match, four players, reconnect)
Board slots and prices come from the engine tracks; unit test compares every fruit column with src/engine/data.ts
Column chips show the same numbers as today's pulse(); unit test
Screenshots of buying with 2, 3 and 4 players at 360x640, 390x844 and desktop; no clipping, overlap or sideways scrolling (automated check)
Rival drop-down shows only stock and cash; online secret-price leak check stays at 0
Old saves still load; RULES_VERSION unchanged
